lines.zh: 鱼尾拍着礁石，我跟上前面那两道水痕。
lines.en: My tail slaps the reef as I follow the two wakes ahead.

lines.zh: 礁缝里的水很浅，我贴着沙滑过去。
lines.en: The water in the crevice is shallow; I glide along the sand.

lines.zh: 三姐妹围成半个圈，慢慢向浅滩游。
lines.en: Three of us curve into a half ring, drifting toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 鳞片擦过礁面，留下一道亮痕。
lines.en: My scales scrape the rock and leave a bright streak.

lines.zh: 我唱着歌，绕开岸边那圈浮木。
lines.en: I swim singing, skirting the driftwood that rings the shore.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，我钻进礁石背后的暗流。
lines.en: One flick of my tail, and I slip into the current behind the reef.

lines.zh: 水面下的光斑跟着我一起挪。
lines.en: The patches of light under the surface shift along with me.

lines.zh: 绕过这块黑礁，就看得见搁浅的船。
lines.en: Past this black rock, the grounded hull comes into view.

lines.zh: 湿发贴在肩上，我抬手把它拨开。
lines.en: Wet hair clings to my shoulder; I brush it aside.

lines.zh: 我沿着退潮的水线，一寸寸地找。
lines.en: I search inch by inch along the line the ebb tide left.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴在浅水里画出并排的弧。
lines.en: Two tails draw side-by-side arcs in the shallows.

lines.zh: 浪打过来，我借它的力往前送。
lines.en: A wave rolls in, and I let it carry me forward.

lines.zh: 礁顶的鸟叫得烦，我沉到水下去。
lines.en: The birds on the reef are noisy; I sink beneath the water.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙底比真身长得多。
lines.en: My shadow on the sandbed is much longer than I am.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁壁的阴影游，避开日光。
lines.en: I swim in the reef's shadow, away from the sun.

lines.zh: 尾尖扫过沙面，留下一道浅沟。
lines.en: My tail tip sweeps the sand into a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 我把嗓子压低，试一个从前用过的调。
lines.en: I lower my voice and try a melody I once used.

lines.zh: 崖上的风把我的歌声送得很远。
lines.en: The cliff wind carries my song a long way off.

lines.zh: 退潮时，礁石露出它尖锐的牙。
lines.en: At low tide the reef bares its sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 数一数，今天礁湾里只来了两个人。
lines.en: Counting them: only two came to the bay today.

lines.zh: 水底那枚耳塞，是有人特意丢下的。
lines.en: That earplug on the seabed was dropped on purpose.

lines.zh: 我哼着调，把尾巴盘在暖石头上。
lines.en: I hum and coil my tail around a sun-warmed stone.

lines.zh: 娜迦的鳞在皮下微微发烫。
lines.en: The naga scales beneath my skin grow faintly warm.

lines.zh: 我记得每一个被歌声引来的人。
lines.en: I remember every one my singing brought here.

lines.zh: 海晶砂粒在沙里，像碎掉的星。
lines.en: Prismarine grit lies in the sand like shattered stars.

lines.zh: 涨潮前我得回到深水那边去。
lines.en: Before the tide turns, I must return to deeper water.

lines.zh: 声音在水里传得比在岸上清楚。
lines.en: Sound carries clearer underwater than it does on land.

lines.zh: 我摸摸喉咙，那里藏着一副好嗓子。
lines.en: I touch my throat, where this fine voice is kept.

lines.zh: 船桅断了半截，斜插在礁缝里。
lines.en: A broken mast leans in the crevice, snapped in half.

lines.zh: 安静时我也在想，歌声之外还剩什么。
lines.en: Quiet now, I wonder what remains of me beyond the song.

lines.zh: 你把木按钮塞进耳朵，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you push those wooden buttons into your ears.

lines.zh: 奇怪，你怎么不朝礁石这边走了。
lines.en: Strange — why do you no longer walk toward the reef?

lines.zh: 你站在水线上，像在等一句邀请。
lines.en: You stand at the waterline, as if waiting to be invited.

lines.zh: 我的歌遇到你的耳塞，就散了。
lines.en: My song meets your earplugs and simply falls apart.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来看水，我先看你的手。
lines.en: You crouch to watch the water; I watch your hands first.

lines.zh: 能听见我吗，还是只听见浪？
lines.en: Can you hear me at all, or only the surf?

lines.zh: 我抬头，湿发遮住半只眼睛。
lines.en: I look up, wet hair covering half of one eye.

lines.zh: 你在岸上走，我在水里跟着你。
lines.en: You walk on the shore; I follow you through the water.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，礁石会咬人的脚。
lines.en: Don't come too close; the reef bites at people's feet.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里没有那种发直的光。
lines.en: Your eyes don't have that glazed, far-off look.

lines.zh: 鳞片裂了几块，我沉到水里。
lines.en: A few scales split; I sink below the surface.

lines.zh: 这一下从我肩上带走了血。
lines.en: That blow took blood from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我退进礁缝，喉咙里发苦。
lines.en: I retreat into the crevice, my throat going bitter.

lines.zh: 尾鳍被划开一道，游起来发沉。
lines.en: A cut opens my tail fin; swimming feels heavy now.

lines.zh: 别打了，我可以不唱歌。
lines.en: Stop hitting me — I can stop singing.

lines.zh: 海水渗进伤口，凉得刺骨。
lines.en: Seawater seeps into the wound, cold enough to sting.

lines.zh: 我没想到你还带着铁器。
lines.en: I didn't think you carried iron with you.

lines.zh: 礁湾的回声把我的痛放大了。
lines.en: The bay's echo makes my pain sound louder.

lines.zh: 我松开手，退到浪线以外。
lines.en: I let go and back off past the break line.

lines.zh: 伤口在咸水里泡着，一时好不了。
lines.en: This wound soaks in salt water and won't close soon.

lines.zh: 岸上有人影，我的调子自己变了。
lines.en: A figure on the shore, and my melody changes on its own.

lines.zh: 那副嗓子又痒了，我忍不住要唱。
lines.en: My throat itches again; I cannot help but sing.

lines.zh: 你手里的鳞片在反光，过来些。
lines.en: The scales in your hand catch the light — come closer.

lines.zh: 礁湾太静了，我需要一点动静。
lines.en: The bay is too still; I need some sound in it.

lines.zh: 我顺着那股暖流游向浅滩。
lines.en: I ride that warm current in toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 人一多，我的歌就有了回音。
lines.en: With more of you here, my song begins to echo.

lines.zh: 水里飘来铁的味道，我抬起头。
lines.en: The smell of iron drifts through the water; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 这块礁石正对着你走来的路。
lines.en: This rock sits right across the path you're taking.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴藏进浪里，只露出脸。
lines.en: I hide my tail in the surf and show only my face.

lines.zh: 再往前三步，水就没到膝盖了。
lines.en: Three more steps and the water will reach your knees.

lines.zh: 你撞上我时，我身上的水全溅开了。
lines.en: When you bump into me, the water on my skin flies off.

lines.zh: 别踩我的尾巴，那截会疼很久。
lines.en: Don't step on my tail; that part aches for a long while.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞过来，我退了半步进水。
lines.en: A shoulder shoves me, and I step back into the water.

lines.zh: 湿滑的礁面让我站不太稳。
lines.en: The slick reef makes it hard for me to stand firm.

lines.zh: 你推我一下，鳞片竖起了一片。
lines.en: One push from you, and a ridge of my scales stands up.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，歌声断了半拍。
lines.en: We collide, and the song breaks for half a beat.

lines.zh: 这地方太窄，两个人错不开身。
lines.en: This gap is too narrow for two of us to pass.

lines.zh: 我的手肘碰到你，凉得像海水。
lines.en: My elbow brushes you, cold as seawater.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一块海晶砂，我听见了。
lines.en: You crushed a piece of prismarine grit; I heard it.

lines.zh: 退开点，我的尾鳍扫得到你。
lines.en: Step back; my tail fin can sweep that far.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴缠在一起，礁湾安静下来。
lines.en: Two tails twine, and the bay goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我对她唱了只有我们会的那个调。
lines.en: I sing her the one melody only we two know.

lines.zh: 在礁背的浅坑里，我们把卵埋好。
lines.en: In the hollow behind the reef, we bury the eggs.

lines.zh: 她的鳞比我的亮，靠水那面更亮。
lines.en: Her scales are brighter than mine, especially toward the water.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块礁石游了三圈。
lines.en: We circle the same rock three times together.

lines.zh: 两副嗓子合起来，浪都退了半分。
lines.en: Two voices joined, and even the surf draws back a little.

lines.zh: 她点头，把尾尖搭在我的尾上。
lines.en: She nods and lays her tail tip over mine.

lines.zh: 这个礁湾够深，能养大一窝小鱼。
lines.en: This bay runs deep enough to raise a brood.

lines.zh: 我们约好，涨潮时一起下到深处。
lines.en: We agree to go down together when the tide rises.

lines.zh: 成对的时候，歌声会低一个调。
lines.en: Paired up, our singing drops a note lower.

lines.zh: 这枚海晶碎片归我了，收进鳞缝。
lines.en: This prismarine shard is mine; I tuck it between scales.

lines.zh: 闪光鳞片从指间滑下去，我抓紧。
lines.en: A shining scale slips through my fingers; I grip it.

lines.zh: 船上掉下的铜片，我先捡起来。
lines.en: A copper scrap fell from the boat; I take it first.

lines.zh: 沙里翻出一枚砂粒，颜色很好看。
lines.en: I turn up a grain of prismarine — a lovely color.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，游回礁背去藏。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth and swim back to hide it.

lines.zh: 这块骨头适合磨成一支小梳子。
lines.en: This bone would grind down nicely into a small comb.

lines.zh: 我拾起那片鱼鳞，它不属于我。
lines.en: I pick up that fish scale; it isn't one of mine.

lines.zh: 沉船的钉子上还挂着一缕布。
lines.en: A strip of cloth still hangs from a wreck's nail.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我都往礁缝里塞。
lines.en: Anything bright, I stuff into the cracks of the reef.

lines.zh: 多一枚鳞片，礁里的收藏就多一分。
lines.en: One more scale, and my reef hoard grows by one.

lines.zh: 他听见歌声了，脚步开始偏。
lines.en: He hears the song; his steps begin to drift.

lines.zh: 有个类人生物走下沙滩，我盯住了。
lines.en: A humanoid walks down the beach; I've marked him.

lines.zh: 耳朵空着的人，最容易上钩。
lines.en: Those with bare ears are the easiest to hook.

lines.zh: 他朝礁石来了，我收了半个音。
lines.en: He's coming toward the reef; I swallow half a note.

lines.zh: 这个人的眼睛已经不对了。
lines.en: This one's eyes have already gone wrong.

lines.zh: 浪声盖住了我靠近时的那点响动。
lines.en: The surf covers the little noise I make closing in.

lines.zh: 选他，因为他走得最靠水。
lines.en: I choose him because he walks nearest the water.

lines.zh: 我在他背后浮出水面，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I surface behind him, showing only my eyes.

lines.zh: 他把耳塞捏在手里，还没戴上。
lines.en: He holds the earplugs in his hand, not yet wearing them.

lines.zh: 猎物停在礁尖上，我数到三。
lines.en: The prey stops at the reef's tip; I count to three.

lines.zh: 绕着这块礁，他跑不过我。
lines.en: Around this rock, he cannot outrun me.

lines.zh: 我的歌只对他一个人收紧。
lines.en: My song draws tight around him alone.

lines.zh: 水里是我的地界，他还在岸上。
lines.en: The water is my ground; he's still on the sand.

lines.zh: 再走两步，我就能碰到他脚踝。
lines.en: Two more steps and I can reach his ankle.

lines.zh: 他举起木棍，我不怕那东西。
lines.en: He raises a wooden club; I don't fear that.

lines.zh: 我贴近水面，把呼吸压在浪下。
lines.en: I hug the surface, holding my breath under the wave.

lines.zh: 这个人的靴子太重，跑不快。
lines.en: His boots are heavy; he won't run fast.

lines.zh: 等浪退，我就从礁缝里出来。
lines.en: When the wave pulls back, I come out of the crevice.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的脚，不看他的脸。
lines.en: I watch his feet, not his face.

lines.zh: 距离够了，娜迦的鳞开始发热。
lines.en: Close enough now; the naga scales begin to burn.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽在他腿上，他跪进浅水。
lines.en: My tail cracks across his legs, and he drops to the shallows.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，湿手掐住他的手腕。
lines.en: I lunge and clamp my wet hand on his wrist.

lines.zh: 礁石替我挡住了他挥来的刀。
lines.en: The reef takes the blade he swings at me.

lines.zh: 指甲嵌进他的袖子，他挣不开。
lines.en: My nails sink into his sleeve; he can't pull free.

lines.zh: 我把他往深水里拖，浪盖过头。
lines.en: I drag him toward deep water; a wave closes over him.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬住他手里的绳，绳断了。
lines.en: My teeth catch the cord in his hand; it snaps.

lines.zh: 他踉跄一下，正撞上礁石的尖。
lines.en: He staggers, straight onto the pointed reef.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，整个人的重量压下去。
lines.en: I leap, dropping the whole weight of me on him.

lines.zh: 湿滑的沙让他使不上力气。
lines.en: The wet sand gives his feet nothing to push against.

lines.zh: 这一击之后，歌声又响起来了。
lines.en: After that blow, the singing starts up again.

lines.zh: 礁湾的水刚漫上来，我就醒了。
lines.en: The bay water has barely risen, and I'm already awake.

lines.zh: 我和两个同族一起浮出水面。
lines.en: Two of my kin surface beside me.

lines.zh: 塞壬礁的石头，我摸得出每一块。
lines.en: I know every stone of Siren Reef by touch.

lines.zh: 第一声歌，总是唱给空海听的。
lines.en: The first song is always sung to an empty sea.

lines.zh: 我从深水游上来，尾鳍还带着冷。
lines.en: I rise from deep water, my tail fin still cold.

lines.zh: 三条尾巴分开，各自找一个礁口。
lines.en: Three tails part ways, each to its own gap in the reef.

lines.zh: 水面上的月亮碎成了很多片。
lines.en: The moon on the water breaks into many pieces.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在暗处泛出淡青的光。
lines.en: In the dark my scales give off a pale blue light.

lines.zh: 这一带归我们三个，别处更深。
lines.en: This stretch belongs to the three of us; elsewhere is deeper.

lines.zh: 先听，再唱，最后才轮到牙齿。
lines.en: First listen, then sing — the teeth come last.

lines.zh: 火把的水汽糊了我一脸。
lines.en: Steam from the flame fogs my whole face.

lines.zh: 从礁顶摔下来，尾骨先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the reef top and land on my tailbone.

lines.zh: 在水里呛到，这话我说不出口。
lines.en: Choking on water — I'll never say that out loud.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的浪，比刀还难躲。
lines.en: The blast throws up a wave harder to dodge than a blade.

lines.zh: 箭从岸上射来，钉进礁石里。
lines.en: An arrow flies from the shore and sticks in the rock.

lines.zh: 那道紫光让我的鳞片发麻。
lines.en: That violet light leaves my scales numb.

lines.zh: 饿了几天，我连歌都唱不圆。
lines.en: Days without food, and I can't even sing a full note.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我整个人都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water; my whole body locks up.

lines.zh: 没有水的虚空，我什么也抓不住。
lines.en: A void with no water in it, and nothing to hold.
